name: ddd
description: Domain-driven design and contract completeness for every design session. Subdomain distillation, model-sized bounded contexts, entity/VO/enum-classified objects each documented in one self-contained section with every field, behavior, relationship cardinality and state, optionality justified rather than assumed, later facts as their own tables instead of nullable columns, constructor-enforced invariants, aggregate discipline with domain events, anti-corruption layers, then API, domain event and DDL contracts each defined to 100% and cross-checked, captured as a context map, a domain model and an ADR before code.
